name: silveram-storefront

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); rmSync('server.js', { force: true });"
scripts.validate: npm run build && npm --prefix server run check && npm --prefix server test

description: Silveram: silver jewellery & gifting storefront (React + Vite) and Express API on Vercel.
